resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, the complete effective es-419 locale, UI context, glossary, protected-token rules, and an independent linguistic pass were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation metadata, queue validation, type checking, all tests, and the complete production build passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A fresh independent machine critique reviewed the complete published locale and identified 25 actionable findings.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Latin American Spanish human review was performed; corrections remain machine reviewed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: The owner requested continued translation improvement, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Three normalization suffixes omitted the leading space required when appended to a save notice.
evidence: The source suffixes include a leading space and are concatenated directly.
findings.resolution: Restored one leading space in all three normalization suffixes.

findings.summary: The stable gram symbol was expanded to a word.
evidence: Unit symbols are protected presentation tokens.
findings.resolution: Used Peso (g).

findings.summary: The label described a protected state instead of the protection-status field.
evidence: The field distinguishes protected and unprotected cells.
findings.resolution: Used Estado de protección.

findings.summary: The entry count always used a plural noun.
evidence: A count of one requires entrada.
findings.resolution: Added singular and plural count handling.

findings.summary: The category count always used a plural noun.
evidence: A category containing one entry requires entrada.
findings.resolution: Added singular and plural count handling.

findings.summary: The date connector failed for year-only catalog values.
evidence: The placeholder may be a year rather than a full date.
findings.resolution: Used a neutral availability label before the date value.

findings.summary: A generic continuous-discharge rating was narrowed to current even though C ratings are supported.
evidence: The catalog represents continuous-discharge ratings in amperes or C.
findings.resolution: Used clasificación de descarga continua in the empty state and property label.

findings.summary: The classification field was narrowed to chemical composition.
evidence: The source field is Chemistry and contains classifications.
findings.resolution: Used Clasificación química.

findings.summary: The likely supersession warning was weakened to a mere possibility.
evidence: Probably is materially stronger than may have been.
findings.resolution: Restored probablemente ha sido sustituido.

findings.summary: The home description omitted combining wires and the temperature-curve purpose.
evidence: Both functions are named in the canonical description.
findings.resolution: Restored the combined-wire and temperature-curve meaning.

findings.summary: The label conflicted with the locale glossary's preferred term.
evidence: The es-419 glossary prefers líquido para vapear.
findings.resolution: Used Líquido para vapear.

findings.summary: Estimate was rendered as the more certain calculate.
evidence: The calculator output is an engineering estimate.
findings.resolution: Used Estima.

findings.summary: English decimal separators remained in two Spanish technical formulas.
evidence: Decimal points are ambiguous against the locale's established numeric convention.
findings.resolution: Localized 0,8 and 7,2 while preserving every symbol and unit.

findings.summary: The paragraph substituted different components and omitted insulation, uneven heating, resistance change, and continuous-current limits.
evidence: The canonical safety paragraph explicitly covers all of those constraints.
findings.resolution: Retranslated the complete source paragraph faithfully.

findings.summary: The proper name and title were incorrectly lowercased.
evidence: Kirchhoff is a proper name.
findings.resolution: Used Leyes de Kirchhoff.

findings.summary: Current sharing was rendered as an exchange of current.
evidence: Parallel paths distribute or share current; they do not exchange it.
findings.resolution: Used reparto de corriente.

findings.summary: Battery balancing was rendered as a static equilibrium.
evidence: Equilibrado is the process used during series-cell charging.
findings.resolution: Used equilibrado adecuado.

findings.summary: Seventeen instructional strings used formal imperatives in an informal-tú locale.
evidence: The surrounding application consistently addresses the visitor with tú.
findings.resolution: Normalized the affected concept and material-safety instructions to informal imperatives.

findings.summary: The SI physical-quantity header used the generic word for amount.
evidence: Magnitud is the established Spanish metrology term for physical quantity.
findings.resolution: Used Magnitud.

findings.summary: Two inch-conversion formulas retained English decimal separators and unit wording.
evidence: The article otherwise uses Spanish decimal notation.
findings.resolution: Localized the decimal separators and pulgada wording without changing the calculations.

findings.summary: The joule value used an ambiguous English thousands separator.
evidence: The preceding corrected formula establishes 41.800 J.
findings.resolution: Used 41.800 J consistently.

findings.summary: The concept title conflicted with the runtime calculator terminology.
evidence: The article and calculators already use flujo de calor.
findings.resolution: Used Flujo de calor consistently.

findings.summary: An infinitive after a semicolon left the instruction grammatically disconnected.
evidence: The clause directly instructs the visitor how to compute temperature change.
findings.resolution: Used an informal imperative with usa.

findings.summary: The evidence note had malformed word order and incorrect capitalization after a semicolon.
evidence: The source states a 20 A continuous rating and excludes pulse ratings.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the note as a grammatical rating statement.

findings.summary: Two profiles incorrectly made a battery the regulator or made the mod itself an adapter.
evidence: The source describes a regulated mod with an integrated battery and a mod accepting an adapted 18650 cell.
findings.resolution: Restored both device-to-battery and device-to-adapter relationships.
